findings.claim: Legacy attempt_number must never act as an ordinal fallback when canonical attempt_no is absent.
findings.observed: The reducer still assigns number from attempt_number for a legacy-only AttemptStarted and also falls back to attempt_number for AttemptFinished when attempt_no is absent, allowing unsupported alias-only input to create a definite attempt summary.
findings.rationale: The canonical task explicitly says the serializer does not emit attempt_number and forbids adding that alias fallback; accepting it can turn malformed/non-canonical evidence into a certain attempt identity instead of preserving uncertainty or rejecting it.
findings.required: Remove the legacy-only ordinal fallback for AttemptStarted and AttemptFinished; only validated canonical attempt_no may establish a definite attempt number, while contradictory or malformed scope remains explicit uncertainty/evidence.

goals.summary: Monitoring lifecycle: zachovat unscoped evidence a odmítnout rozporný ordinal fallback
